title: Capture-lifetime shutdown: ordering race, added shutdown latency, and concurrent stop_and_join contract
outcome: TermAl shutdown never records a spurious failed runtime-observation closing attempt, its added shutdown latency is bounded and documented (or Engram control calls on observer threads honour capture cancellation), and CaptureLifetime::stop_and_join returns a consistent answer to concurrent callers.
acceptance: The runtime-observation stopping flag is set before captures are cancelled, or the observer worker treats a shutdown-cancelled capture as do-not-install; a test shows that shutdown during an in-flight closing capture does not increment attempts.
The shutdown latency added by joining observer workers (bounded by the 40 s backstop, observers inside Engram adapter calls of up to 20 s) is documented, or those calls honour capture cancellation.
stop_and_join re-checks draining after each wait, so a second concurrent caller cannot return true while a drainer is pending (with a test).
The stale comment at src/bounded_read_process.rs:317 about Unix Git children staying in the checker's process group is corrected.
